topics.label: Introduction to complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals of the complement system and C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, naming conventions, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways through which complement is initiated to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream effector processes driven by complement activation, including opsonization, inflammation, and membrane lysis.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from spontaneous complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how specific deficiencies in complement and regulatory components lead to distinct clinical presentations.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion strategies and applications of protein A
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evade complement attack and how staphylococcal evasion factors are utilized in research and clinical settings.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and frames the upcoming lecture in the series.
